gloss: to join; to become a member; to subscribe

definitions.gloss: to join; to become a member; to subscribe
definitions.explanation: To officially become part of an organization, group, plan, or service.

examples.japanese: {保険|ほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}する。
{組合|くみあい}に{加入|かにゅう}することにした。
examples.english: I decided to join the union.

examples.japanese: この{国|くに}は{昨年|さくねん}{国際|こくさい}{機関|きかん}に{加入|かにゅう}した。
examples.english: This country joined the international organization last year.

notes:
Used for formally joining organizations, subscribing to services, or entering agreements. The particle に marks the group or service being joined. The noun form {加入|かにゅう} is commonly used on its own, especially in compound phrases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保険|ほけん}に{加入|かにゅう}する: to take out insurance
- {組合|くみあい}に{加入|かにゅう}する: to join a union
- {新規|しんき}{加入|かにゅう}: new enrollment
- {加入|かにゅう}{者|しゃ}: subscriber; member
- {加入|かにゅう}{手続|てつづ}き: enrollment procedure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入会|にゅうかい}する: to join (a club or association) — used for clubs, gyms, and membership-based groups, while {加入|かにゅう}する is broader and includes insurance, unions, and international bodies
- {参加|さんか}する: to participate — focuses on taking part in an event or activity, not becoming a formal member
